projects.name: Two-branch campus network (graduation project)
projects.description: Planned IP addressing for 1,200 hosts across 14 departments by subnetting a /20 into right-sized blocks, implemented VLAN separation with trunked links between access and distribution layers, routed between VLANs on a layer-3 switch, ran OSPF in two areas with failover testing, connected branches over an encrypted IPsec tunnel across a simulated ISP, set up centralized DHCP with relays, and documented topology and address plan in Visio with a change log. Built first in Packet Tracer then implemented on six real Cisco 2960 and ISR devices.

projects.name: Faulty lab exercise series (Networks 2 course)
